web.title: How to use Buffer's calendar feature - Buffer Help Center
web.description: July 23, 2026 - You can choose which day of the week appears first in the weekly view of the calendar by changing your Preferences. To do this: Click your profile avatar in the bottom left of your dashboard · Select Settings from the dropdown menu. Select Preferences on the left panel. Under "Start of Week," choose either Sunday or Monday · One of the cool new features within the calendar is the ability to view and plan your content from one or several of your social channels all at once.
